verdict.rationale: Claude Code is fundamentally a built-in AI assistant that plans, writes code, spawns subagents, and executes multi-step delegated tasks autonomously (writing tests, fixing lint, resolving conflicts, updating dependencies) across terminal, IDE, Slack, and web surfaces. This is extensively documented first-party plus corroborated by hands-on community reports of daily multi-language use. missing for 10: independent benchmark-level validation of delegation reliability beyond anecdotal community reports (some of which describe inconsistent quality).
